label: D1 after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode (ep_trial < 40)
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (94% of activation mass) and far more after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward 0 gives 89% of mass). It is also limited to the first ~40 trials of an episode: its rate is highest in trials 1-9, falls steadily through trials 10-39, and it never fires from trial 50 on. So it looks like a slowly decaying early-episode signal, gated by seeing no reward at D1. The top half of activations by magnitude is covered almost completely (99-100%). What the predicate misses are weak activations: D1 after a rewarded trial early in the episode (about 0.1 of max), and GO steps after a reward when the agent picks a1 (about 0.1-0.3 of max). Adding those clauses raises mass recall to 0.95 but drops F1 to 0.49, so they were left out. Within the predicate, false positives are mostly the later part of the 0-40 window, where the unit has already decayed. Never fires at D2 or once a1/a2 is shown as input. Uses only observed variables (prev_reward, phase) plus episode time.
